name: GLM 5.2
short: Z.ai's MIT 753B/40B-active MoE (1M, text-only) for long-horizon coding agents: SWE-bench 82.8% (Vals), Terminal-Bench 2.1 81.0% (vendor) - superseded by GLM-5.3.
standout: The MIT flagship before 5.3: long-horizon coding agents with self-host freedom and honest benchmarking.
tradeoff: Superseded by GLM-5.3’s higher verified scores at the same open-weights posture.
